The original home on this property was built in 1980, where its owners lovingly raised their family for over four decades. In July 2021, we were honored to purchase the property after the family relocated to Texas. With a deep appreciation for its history, we envisioned transforming the homestead into a place where others could gather to celebrate life’s most meaningful moments- filled with love, laughter, and lasting memories.

Shortly after acquiring the property, my beloved grandmother, Josephine, passed away. She was fun-loving, spirited, and proudly Italian, and she had even shared in the excitement of helping us consider names for the venue. When the time came to choose, we wanted something timeless, meaningful, and reflective of our heritage.

The Josephine was chosen in her honor. This place became more than a venue. It became a reflection of everything she was – welcoming, beautiful, and full of life- everything we hope each couple and guest feels during their time here.
